title: Bitcoin analysis eyes ‘serious volume’ after Binance sees 9K BTC daily outflow
summary: Binance set multimonth records for net BTC outflows on Tuesday, adding to an emerging trend of positive inflows to the US spot Bitcoin ETFs.

title: Zilliqa Ledger app vulnerability lets attackers recover signer’s private keys
summary: A security vulnerability in the Zilliqa Ledger app is enabling attackers to reconstruct private keys using publicly available onchain data.

title: US seeks forfeiture of $25M in crypto tied to romance, investment scams
summary: US prosecutors are seeking more than $25 million in cryptocurrency allegedly connected to international fraud and laundering networks.

title: Talos brings institutional trading tools to Kalshi prediction markets
summary: The integration provides institutional clients with access to Kalshi’s event contracts and crypto perpetuals via Talos’ existing trading infrastructure.

title: Crypto institutions look beyond audits as trust signals falter: Hacken
summary: Institutional due diligence is shifting toward continuous monitoring, signer controls and incident readiness after operational failures accounted for most crypto losses.

title: South Korea crypto volumes shrink as retail investors shift to stocks
summary: Trading activity on South Korea’s five major crypto exchanges fell sharply as the KOSPI surged, signaling a shift in retail investors toward equities.

title: Foundry asks Bitcoin miners to vote on BIP-110 support
summary: Foundry USA asked its mining customers to signal their support for BIP-110, an actively debated proposal seeking to shrink the amount of data that can be stored in a Bitcoin transaction.

title: SecondFi to wind down after $2.6M ADA theft linked to wallet flaw
summary: SecondFi will wind down after a $2.6 million ADA theft, while users still await recovery tools that were initially expected within weeks of the exploit.

title: Galaxy pledges $5M for developers quantum-proofing Bitcoin
summary: Galaxy pledged up to $5 million in grants for developers working on Bitcoin’s quantum security and elected a council of quantum-advisory experts to research quantum-resistant migration solutions.

title: Bitcoin ETFs extend inflow streak to 6 days with $203M added
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs extended their inflow streak to six sessions, bringing in about $930 million while remaining down $4.84 billion on a net basis year to date.
